subject.title: [Feature]: Add an optional result-return mode for /hooks/agent

question: Should OpenClaw support synchronous result return for POST /hooks/agent, and if so should the supported contract be waitForResult/announceToMain, a dedicated sync endpoint, or a bounded result-reference fetch flow?
rationale: The feature gap is source-proven, but the fix defines public Gateway HTTP behavior and security-sensitive hook output/audit semantics that automation cannot safely choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt linked PR shape with hardening
options.body: Proceed with waitForResult and announceToMain if maintainers also define output limits, error disclosure, retry, timeout, concurrency, and audit behavior before merge.

options.title: Choose a narrower contract
options.body: Ask the contributor to reshape the PR around a dedicated sync endpoint or short-lived result reference if that better fits the Gateway security boundary.

options.title: Decline core sync hooks
options.body: Keep the async /hooks/agent plus sessions_history workaround and close the linked PR if maintainers do not want this surface in core.

recommendation.title: Adopt linked PR shape with hardening
recommendation.body: Proceed with waitForResult and announceToMain if maintainers also define output limits, error disclosure, retry, timeout, concurrency, and audit behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans public Gateway API shape, docs, and security posture, and this handle has the strongest adjacent gateway history in the reviewed files.
